events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Twenty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. Which track still gets you every time?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, '3 Days of Peace & Music,' began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock. What's your ultimate festival moment from that legendary weekend?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll through the generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That zebra crossing photo is still one of the most famous album covers ever. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the enduring frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Celebration
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever, what's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune with his unmistakable vocals?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years since Apple dropped it and changed the game for music lovers everywhere. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite Bond moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic icon and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite of his unforgettable characters?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track from it is your hidden gem?
